title: Generated Rust public API baseline pilot
objective: Pilot the DEC-051 public API convention on grafting-graph-core with a generated tracked snapshot, deterministic api-check target, enforced Rustdoc coverage, and existing behavioral contract tests.
validations: cargo fmt check passed for grafting-graph-core
cargo check and cargo clippy passed for all grafting-graph-core targets and features with warnings denied

grafting-graph-core tests passed with all features: three unit tests, two Graph IR CLI tests, the public consumer contract, and the negative baseline drift test; the nightly snapshot test is deliberately ignored only in ordinary test runs
generated public API snapshot comparison passed with nightly-2025-11-23 and Rustdoc JSON format 57
cargo doc passed for grafting-graph-core with missing documentation and broken links denied
Nx graph-core:api-check passed with cache bypass, running snapshot comparison, negative drift detection, and the compile-time consumer contract
cargo metadata verified exact extraction dependency versions and licenses; cargo tree verified they do not enter the normal runtime dependency graph
Nx project graph and the derived Graph IR candidate were refreshed with the completed task state
coordination validation and control-plane audit passed with zero model calls and zero side effects
risks: Rustdoc JSON remains nightly-only and its format can change; exact pins make an intentional compatibility update necessary before changing the extraction toolchain.
The generated baseline complements rather than replaces independent consumer and behavioral contract tests.
I-003B still needs to evaluate TypeScript, C#, and Python native extractors before the convention is repository-wide.

The local pnpm node_modules links were incomplete and an active Node process prevented a frozen offline relink; the Nx target still passed through the installed workspace binary, and clean CI installs remain the authoritative integration path.
